questions.q_en: The total age of Amit and Suvarna on 1 January 2015 is 61 years. Amit is three years younger than Suvarna. What was the age of Suvarna on 1 January 2010?

options_hi: 29 वर्ष
34 वर्ष
27 वर्ष
32 वर्ष
questions.solution_en:
A + S = 61                {on 1 Jan 2015}
S A = 3
Adding both the above equations→
2S = 64
S = 32
Age before 5 years = 32 5 = 27 yrs
questions.solution_hi:
उपरोक्त दोनों समीकरणों को जोड़ने पर→
2S = 64
S = 32
5 वर्ष पहले की आयु = 32 – 5 = 27 वर्ष
